scope: Two static texture trials; existing storyboard and refined sources remain unchanged.

assets.prompt:
Edit the supplied refined pixel-art classroom frame, making ONLY a very light material-texture pass. Preserve its current composition, every student, anatomy, furniture, horizontal sliding windows, colors, matte lighting, and crisp pixel RPG drawing. Retain the corrected eye anatomy of the brown-haired boy at the frontmost occupied desk at lower left, whose cheek rests on his hand: both calm open eyes, aligned naturally, looking right. Preserve ALL faces and eyes as drawn; do not redesign any person.

Add restrained, sparse, low-contrast square pixel grain to a few large surfaces: the tan floor, desk wood, and flat areas of cabinet paint. Use tiny intentional pixel clusters and occasional two-tone dithering near shadow transitions, using neighboring colors already in the picture. Most surface pixels stay flat and clean. Texture should be just noticeable at normal viewing size, never busy. Keep the current matte floor; no glossy golden reflections. Do NOT add photographic film noise, random full-image speckles, scratches, wear, blur, glow, or extra detail. No grain on skin, eyes, hands, face outlines, books' printed pages, or the subtitle panel. Keep the logical pixel grid consistent.

Preserve the entire bottom navy subtitle panel and its exact clean white Chinese text and line breaks:
不知道大家的中学生活是怎么样的？
主播高中的教室是狭窄逼仄的。
Return the same full landscape frame, no crop, no added border.
caption_lines: 不知道大家的中学生活是怎么样的？
